items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Ernie Fields) does not mention Nat Towles in his own turns. The interviewer mentions playing with Nat Towles and working with him, but the interviewee only responds to other topics or general statements, never confirming a personal or professional relationship with Towles.

ctx.x: No, it started with an I. I believe it's Iller or something like that. Anyway, Harold Iller, he took Luther West's place; have you heard of the Happy Hour? I went into the Happy Hour in Minneapolis--
We played with Nat Towles, just ahead of you.
Yeah. Well I went in there for two weeks and stayed four, and so--
